Track the pre-existing ratchet debt in #389 and reject further unreviewed workflow changes.

Every other finding and the missing reductions in these files are the items reviewed and recorded for #404-#412 by the previous records (value-type snapshot fields, noexcept containment catch-alls, the private runtime include, Win32 window and job handles, the restore worker's stop-required acquisition and native test fixtures), carried over with lines shifted by the inserted code. #432 makes the C++ worker trampoline contain every exception before control returns to Rust (#267 G2.2). Each new finding was reviewed. None of them holds product state. Track the pre-existing ratchet debt in #389 and reject later unreviewed changes to these files.
